name: iteration
description: 16-question discrimination-weighted subset for iteration rounds (32 runs at --repeats 2 vs 80 for the full set). Curated 2026-07-08 from R010-R014 variance: signal = cross-round judge spread, noise = same-round rep disagreement. Excluded: django-symbol-01 and django-negative-01 (always 10, zero signal), wolfmax-concept-04 and django-arch-02 (rep noise >= 4, pure noise), django-multi-hop-02 (turn-cap bimodal; a cap-policy stress test, poisons A/B means). Full 40-question fixtures remain the release gate.
